item.title: Lightning strikes early, often to send Maple Leafs to seventh straight loss
item.description: The Maple Leafs could play a spoiler role down the stretch. For now, they remain plain rotten. item.title: SUNshine Girl Candace
item.description: SUNshine Girl Candace is a fashionista, beauty guru, model and makeup boss who goes by nom de plume The Pretty Witch. She has a unique style and loves her Louboutins and tattoos. Candace, who posed for us in April 2017, also loves the boys of summer — the Toronto Blue Jays. (Jack Boland/Toronto Sun)
